book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Ruuka

content: Omuguungibhwa Teofiro, garya gaakorirwe gati weetu, abhaatu bhaaru bhakoriri omukya gwo okukaama iguru yaku.
Gakaamirwe bhwaheene amangʼana gano twabhuuriirwe na bhano bhaagaruuzi amangʼana gayo, kwa ameeso gaabhu, bhano bhakunyaragania engʼana ya Taatabhugya kurwa obhweemero.
Noosi nigiisuunziri no okugamenyeekererya bhwaheene, kyeego goosi gakorirwe kisi kweemera kubhutaangiro, nikarora ni kisi nikukaamire gayo ngʼorangʼora,
okubha obhe no obhuheene kugarya wegiibhwe.
Obhurooti bhwo okwiibhurwa kwa Yohana Omubatiizi
Eriibhaga Herode
yaari omutemi wa Yudea, ahaabha ariho omuseengeri
wumwe wa Taatabhugya, eriina ryaaye Zakaria, yaari musaango yo obhuseengeri bhwa Abiya. Na mukaaye Erizabeti, ewe yaari wa mukisyooko kyo omuseengeri Haruuni.
Abhabhiri bhayo, bhaari abhaheene embere wa Taatabhugya, ebho bhaari bhariigwa emigiro gyo Omukuru gyoosi, okutama kubha ni isoro.
Bhatahaabha no omwaana, kwo okubha Erizabeti yaari muguumba, neebho bhaari bhakuunguhiri bhukongʼu.
Orusiku rumwe, esaango ya Zakaria yaari erakora ruunga rwaaye rwo obhuseengeri embere wa Taatabhugya.
Kunyaangi yo obhuseengeri bhwaabhu, Zakaria akasorwa kwo okwiitoorwa obhwiitoori kubha, niwe araasikire ahahoreeru he eriiseengerero
ryo Omukuru, Taatabhugya, okubha amuguundirirye omuruumbaaso.
Kwiibhaga ryo okwookya omuruumbaaso, habhoori bhakiikumania abhaatu bhaaru kumusabha Taatabhugya.
Niho, Zakaria akahwaarukirwa na maraika
wo Omukuru. Maraika wuyo, akiimeerera orubhaara rwo obhuryo rwa ahagiro he ezahaabu ho okuguundirirya omuruumbaaso.
Hano Zakaria yamuruuzi, akiitakya no okwoobhoha bhukongʼu!
Nawe, maraika akamubhuurira, “Awe Zakaria, otoobhoha! Taatabhugya yiigwiiri amasabhi gaazo. Mukaazo Erizabeti, arakwiibhurira omwaana we ekisubhe, oramutoga eriina Yohana.
Omwaana wuyo, niwe araakore muzomererwe no okuriiryaata, na abhaatu bhaaru bharazomererwa kwo okwiibhurwa kwaaye.
Arabha omukuru embere wa Omukuru. Ataanywe amaanzi go omuzabibu
ne ebhiindi bhyoosi bhino bhikugwaata. Arabha yiizuriibhwe Ekoro Muhoreeru
kurwa muunda ya nina.
Arakyoorya Abhiiziraeri bhaaru kwo Omukuru, Taatabhugya waabhu.
Aramukaangatira Omukuru okubha amubhanurire abhaatu okumusuungʼaana obhuuzi bhwaaye no okukaangatibhwa ne ekoro no obhunagya kya bhwa Eriya.
Arabhagwaatania bhataata na abhaana bhaabhu, no okubhakora bhano bhatakumwiigwa Omukuru bhabhe na amangʼeeni ge eheene.”
Zakaria akamubhuurya maraika, “Ndora enye na mukaane tukuunguhiri! Niki kiraanierekye obhuheene bhwo okubhona omwaana?”
Maraika wuyo akabhuga, “Enye neenye Gaburieri, nikwiimeerera embere wa Taatabhugya. Ewe niwe anitumiri kubha, niize kukubhuurira amangʼana gano amazomu.
Kwo okubha otiikiriirye gano nakubhuuriiri, kweema bhoono orabha imuumu, na otakunagya kugaamba tee, kuhikira gayo garaakorwe kwiibhaga ryaaye.”
Abhaatu bhaari bharaganya Zakaria ahuruke igutu, bhakaruguura kurora kyeego yakezeerimu.
Hano yaahurukirimu, ataanagirye kweeki kukeerenia nabho, akageenderera kubha imuumu. Yaari areerekya kwa amabhoko, bhakamenya kubha aruuzi obhurori.
Hano yamariri eziisiku zaaye zo okukora emirimo mwiiseengerero, akagya yiika.
Kyaamwe, mukaaye Erizabeti akagega enda, akamara emyeeri etaano yaari akiibhisa,
akabhuga, “Omukuru, niwe anikoreeri ego! Anduusiirye eziisoni embere wa abhaatu.”
Obhurooti bhwo okwiibhurwa kwa Yeesu
Hano enda ya Erizabeti yahikirye emyeeri esaasabha, Taatabhugya akatuma maraika Gaburieri mumugye gwa Nazareeti, mukyaaro kya Gariraaya.
Akatumwa kumuukya wumwe, eriina ryaaye Mariamu, yaari ayuungiibhwe no omusubhe wumwe, eriina ryaaye Yusufu, we ekisyooko kyo omutemi Daudi.
Hano maraika yagiiri ku Mariamu, akamubhuurira, “Ndakukeerya, awe omutweerwa we ebhite, Omukuru ari hamwe naawe.”
Hano akiigwa amangʼana gayo, akanyaaka mukoro, akiibhuurya, “Nkeeryaki yino?”
Maraika akamubhuurira, “Weyaa Mariamu, otoobhoha! Omutweerwa we ebhite wa Taatabhugya.
Rora! Oragega enda, na oriibhura omwaana we ekisubhe, oramutoga eriina ryaaye Yeesu.

Arabha omukuru, arabhirikirwa Omwaana wa Taatabhugya Wuno Ari Iguru we Ebhigiro Bhyoosi. Omukuru, Taatabhugya arabhwiimeererya kweeki obhukaangati bhwo obhutemi bhwa Daudi isikuru waaye, no okumuha omwaana wuyo.
Arabha omutemi wa abhaatu bhoosi bha Iziraeri kirakeego, no obhutemi bhwaaye, bhutakubha no obhuteero.”
Mariamu akabhuurya, “Garabhabhwi, neenye nitakaruuzi omusubhe?”

Akamukyoora, “Ekoro Muhoreeru arakwiikira, na amanaga ga Taatabhugya Wuno Ari Iguru we Ebhigiro Bhyoosi, garakukuundikiirya. Kweego, omwaana wuno akwiibhurwa, arabha omusorwa no okutogwa Omwaana wa Taatabhugya.
Naabhe omuhiiri waazo Erizabeti, wuno abhaatu bhaari bhamumenyiri kubha ni muguumba, agegiri enda yo omwaana we ekisubhe mubhukikuru bhwaaye. Bhoono ariinda ya emyeeri esaasabha.
Gayo gaatuukiri kwo okubha ku Taatabhugya, bhyoosi bhiraturikana.”
Mariamu akabhuga, “Neenye omugya wo Omukuru, ebhe kweenye kyeego ogaambiri.” Kyaamwe akagya.
Mariamu aragya kukeerya Erizabeti
Mariamu akakora bhwaangu orugeendo, rwo okugya ku Erizabeti eziisiku ziyoziyo, mumugye gumwe gwe ebhiguru bhya Yudea.
Hano yasikiiri wa Zakaria, akamukeerya Erizabeti.
Hano Erizabeti akiigwa akeeriibhwe na Mariamu, omwaana yaari muunda yaaye akatumatuma. Hayohayo Erizabeti akiizuribhwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru,
kyaamwe akagaamba kwiiraka ikuru, “Mubhakari bhoosi, awe naawe omutweerwa we ebhite! No oriibhura omwaana omutweerwa ebhite.
Enye ni weewi, naabhe nina wo Omukuru waane yiize kunikeerya?
Hano niigwiiri oranikeerya, omwaana akatumatuma muunda yaane kwo obhuzomererwa.
Awe naawe omutweerwa ebhite, kwo okubha wiikiriirye gano Omukuru yakubhuuriiri gakorwe.”
Omweembo gwa Mariamu
Mariamu akabhuga,

content.text: Kurwa bhoono, abhaatu bhe eziinyiibhuro zyoosina zino zikuuza,
bharabha bharanibhirikira kubha neenyeomutweerwa we ebhite,
ne eriina ryaaye ni ihoreeru, rirakira amariina goosi.
no okubhasakirya abhaatu bhe eziinyiibhuro zyoosi,
Akoriri amangʼana amakuru kwa amanaga gookubhoko kwaaye,
Yiituumirye abhakaangati kurwa kubhituumbi bhyaabhu bhyo obhutemi,
Akakora kyeego yaragiri Aburahamu na bhazaazi bheetu,
na abhaatu bhe ehamati yaaye kirakeego.”

content: Mariamu akamara emyeeri etatu ari we Erizabeti, niho yagarukiri yiika waaye.
Okwiibhurwa kwa Yohana Omubatiizi
Eziisiku zo okwiibhura kwe Erizabeti zikahika, akiibhura omwaana we ekisubhe.
Hano abhanyaroobho na abhahiiri bhaaye bhakiigwa kyeego Omukuru yamuroreeri ebhigoongi bhyaaru, bhakazomererwa hamwe neewe.
Omwaana wuyo, hano yahikirye orusiku rwa kanaane, bhakaaza kumusaara.
Bhakeenda kumutoga eriina rya wiise Zakaria.
Kyaamwe, nina akaanga, akabhuga, “Zeyi, atogwe Yohana.”
Bhakamukyoora, “Ndora eriina riyo ritari mubhahiiri bheenyu!”
Niho, bhakabhuurya wiise, kwo okumweerekya na amabhoko, abhazweenie kyeego akweenda atoge omwaana waaye.
Akasabha ekigiro kyo okukaamira, akakaama, “Eriina ryaaye niwe Yohana.” Bhoosi ego bhakaruguura!
Kyaamwe, omunwa gwaaye gukiigurwa, kweeki akabha aragaamba, akumukumya Taatabhugya.
Abhanyaroobho bhoosi, bhakahaha, engʼana yiyo ekanyaragana bhukongʼu mbaara zoosi ze ebhiguru bhya Yudea.
Kwo okubha bhoosi bhakiigwa obhunagya bhwo Omukuru bhwaari hamwe neewe, bhakabha bhakiibhuurya, “Omwaana wuyo arabha muutuki?”
Omweembo gwa Zakaria
Zakaria, wiise wo omwaana wuyo, akiizuribhwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru, akagaamba obhurooti,

content.text: kwo okubha yiiziri kututuurya etwe abhaatu bhaaye.
Taatabhugya atureeteeri Omutuurya weetu wa amanaga,
omwiibhurwa we ekisyooko kya Daudi, omuhokya waaye,
kyeego yaragiri ekare hayo kubharooti bhaaye abhahoreeru.
na mumabhoko ga bhoosi bhano bhakutubhiihirirya.
Akabhuga kubha, arabharorera ebhigoongi bhazaazi bheetu
Eriiragano riyo niryo akakora na zaazi weetu Aburahamu.
Tutuuriibhwe kurwa mumabhoko ga abhabhisa bheetu,
okubha tumuseengere, kutama kubha ne ehaha,
tubhe bhahoreeru na abhaheene embere waaye,
orabhirikirwa omurooti wa Taatabhugya Wuno Ari Iguru we Ebhigiro Bhyoosi.
abhone omweererye abhaatu kuziinzira zino araahitire.
bharatuuribhwa kwo okwaabhirwa kwe ebhibhi bhyaabhu,
kwe ebhigoongi bhyaaru no obhunyoohu bhwa Taatabhugya weetu.
No obhutuuribhwa bhuyo bhuratuhwaarukira kyo obhweero kurwa iguru.
na bhano bhakwoobhoha enyaako yo oruku runorwaari kuuza.

content: Yohana akakiina, akabha na amanaga mukoro yaaye, akagya kwiikara mwiitirigo tee, hano eriibhaga ryahikiri akarweera mu Bhiiziraeri.
